notes: The parent manifest enumerates CBZ chapter resources; it does not flatten all image pages.
Plain and Reader-style selected directory variants run in separate fresh CLI processes, including separate serial-cold and burst processes.
Selected registration is measured separately; cold_selected_open_total includes registration plus first manifest, excluding CLI startup.
Same loopback identity-encoded HTTP, GOMAXPROCS and filesystem cache policy as existing baselines; client/NAS caches are not flushed.
Cache pressure opens twelve individual chapter publications, then revisits the parent. Media are read in place and never copied for timing.
Toolkit revision was explicitly declared for the measured binary; the harness checkout may differ. Binary build information and SHA-256 are recorded separately.
